earlier_scan.source_named: Glottolog: code retired; Yauma is a geographic label for Mbunda [mck] speakers (Papstein 1994, Barrett 2004); no distinct description exists.

sources.note: Yauma appears only in Fortune 1963 lexicostatistics (p.59). Sec. 3.4 (pp.70-71), for Zambian languages generally: 'syllables are more or less evenly stressed.. In some languages (e.g. Cewa) the penultimate syllable seems to be pronounced with slightly greater force.. stress in Zambian languages does not distinguish words'. Not specific to Yauma/Mbunda.
